study type: Secondary analysis of an obstetric cohort
cohort: 19,611 low-risk, term, nulliparous patients with singleton, nonanomalous vertex fetuses, admitted with an intent for VD ≥ 37 weeks
finding: A logistic regression model including maternal age, BMI, cervical dilatation, and gestational age on admission accurately predicted the probability of VD (ROC-AUC of 0.71) and showed that the prevalences of severe maternal and neonatal morbidity decreased as the predicted probability of VD increased.
mod_finding: The study developed a model to predict the probability of vaginal delivery in low-risk nulliparous patients, but did not directly investigate factors influencing mode of delivery.
